text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning, Air Groove was
already standing in front of the school gate.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! Good morning!
You're awfully early today!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I woke up feeling quite refreshed today.
So I decided I would come by and offer my greetings.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then I'll come along too!
After all, I am on the Disciplinary Committee!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Air Groove and Bamboo Memory's energetic morning greetings echoed throughout the entire academy.
